notes.title: Update Notes January 27, 2021
notes.content:
Version 1.1.2 is now live on Windows!
[list]
[*] Darkness is now mostly dark instead of pitch black, because I don't actually hate fun.
[*] Minor adjustments to the tutorial area to clarify a few key gameplay mechanics.
[*] There is now a dog in the concept art room. You can pet it.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
